name: Historic Site of Lyon
description: Lyon's historic centre in eastern France began as a Roman capital of the Three Gauls in the 1st century B.C. Its Old Town, squeezed between Fourvière hill and the Saône, is one of Europe's largest Renaissance districts. You can wander past the Gothic cathedral, Italian bankers' mansions and the traboules, hidden passages with spiral staircases that cut through buildings from street to street.
